Package com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp

Class SnmpTrapReceiver

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpTrapReceiver
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class SnmpTrapReceiver extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Listens on a UDP port (default 162) for incoming SNMP v1 / v2c traps and notifications over SNMP4J, decoding each into an immutable SnmpTrapReceiver.Trap record and delivering it to a registered listener. The transport/dispatcher is community-based (the same single-argument Snmp constructor the browser uses, which registers the v1/v2c message-processing models).

The decoding helpers — isTrap(int), trapOidOf(org.snmp4j.PDU) and decode(PDU, String, String, Instant) — are pure and unit-tested offline by building a PDU in-process; the full start(int) ⇒ receive path is exercised against a loopback ephemeral port.

      public static String trapOidOf(org.snmp4j.PDU pdu)
      Extracts the notification OID: for v2c/v3 it is the value of snmpTrapOID.0; for v1 it is derived from the generic / specific trap numbers and the enterprise OID per RFC 3584 §3.1 (generic ⇒ 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.(generic+1); enterprise-specific ⇒ <enterprise>.0.<specific>).
